title: SatDeed Record v0.1
description: A SatDeed record. Note that schema validity is necessary but not sufficient: a record must also satisfy the derivation, canonicalization and signature rules in SPECIFICATION.md, which a JSON Schema cannot express.

satdeed.description: Specification version this record claims to follow.

asset_uid.description: The 32 byte derived asset identifier, lowercase hex.

issuer_id.description: Stable lowercase label for the issuer. A DNS name is the recommended form because it is already globally unique and already has an owner.

public_key.description: 32 byte x only secp256k1 public key, as used by BIP-340.

issued_at.description: UTC, whole seconds, Z suffix. The issuer's own clock, with no evidentiary weight of its own. The anchoring block is what establishes a time the record could not predate.

supersedes.description: Record hash of the record this one replaces.

asset_id.description: Crockford base32 display form of the first 20 bytes of asset_uid, with a four character checksum.

asset_class.description: Open vocabulary. Registered values in v0.1: vehicle, real_property, warehouse_receipt, equipment, commodity, invoice, intellectual_property.

verification_level.description: Evidence class, not a legal ranking. See SPECIFICATION.md section 9.

attributes.description: Public, non sensitive descriptive attributes. Anything that could identify a person, or that has low enough entropy to be guessed, belongs in attribute_commitments instead.

storage.description: Hints only. An empty array is valid and means the holder keeps the document. A verifier must never treat a storage reference as authoritative.
